bias: 'I could almost shorten today's post to Let's do it again.' Re-read the weekly plan — the framework is intact and the weekly levels performed well Monday. The most meaningful development: NQ took out Friday's low while ES held above its own (Monday's low 7570.75 held the major 7569-7575, the level whose break ended monthly OTFU) — that distinction could matter as Tuesday develops. Today's ES high 7693.75 matched Friday's 5 AM ETH lower high exactly (the 7689-7694 daily he meant to add) — mark it and don't remove it until it trades; it's an obvious upside target for longs at some point this week.
wildcard: Election Tuesday — 'things could get nuts, both intraday and throughout the night'; be particularly cautious carrying overnight positions you can't adjust or hedge outside RTH. Monday's failed move higher weakens the LBAF setups somewhat, 'however, with the election tomorrow, I wouldn't rule out much of anything.' Still no interest in initiating new shorts into fresh lows on NQ, but it's objectively a continuation short below Monday's low.
